description: This file defines a Perl module `Git::Packet` that provides functions for reading, writing, and handling Git protocol packets in binary and text form, including capability negotiation and packet validation.

methods.name: packet_compare_lists
methods.description: Compares two lists for equality, returning 1 if they match, undefined otherwise.

methods.name: packet_bin_read
methods.description: Reads a binary packet from STDIN, returning status and content.

methods.name: remove_final_lf_or_die
methods.description: Removes a final newline from a buffer or dies if not terminated properly.

methods.name: packet_txt_read
methods.description: Reads a text packet, expecting LF-terminated data.

methods.name: packet_key_val_read
methods.description: Reads a key=value pair and verifies that the key matches the expected key.

methods.name: packet_bin_write
methods.description: Writes binary data to STDOUT with length prefix.

methods.name: packet_txt_write
methods.description: Writes text data as a binary packet with newline termination.

methods.name: packet_flush
methods.description: Flushes the packet stream by writing a zero-length packet.

methods.name: packet_initialize
methods.description: Performs protocol handshake initialization with the remote Git client/server.

methods.name: packet_read_capabilities
methods.description: Reads capabilities from the other end of the connection.

methods.name: packet_read_and_check_capabilities
methods.description: Reads remote capabilities and verifies required ones.

methods.name: packet_check_and_write_capabilities
methods.description: Checks local capabilities against remote ones and advertises capabilities.
